changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A scheduler finds whose work is due without reading anyone's rows: it gets only the key, the workspace, the account and the due time of each due row, oldest first, a page at a time.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mentoring_due_work( work_kind text, due_before timestamp with time zone, after_due timestamp with time zone, after_id uuid, max_rows integer) RETURNS TABLE (kind text, id uuid, workspace_id bigint, account_id bigint, due_at timestamp with time zone) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$ BEGIN -- A page starts after the row (after_due, after_id) of the previous page, or at the oldest row when both are null. IF due_before IS NULL OR max_rows IS NULL OR max_rows < 0 OR (after_due IS NULL) <> (after_id IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'mentoring_due_work: needs a cutoff, a limit and a whole cursor or none' USING ERRCODE = 'invalid_parameter_value'; END IF; IF work_kind = 'ENTRY_RETENTION' THEN -- A conversation entry is due when it was written before the retention cutoff and is not erased yet. due_at is -- the time it was written. IF after_due IS NULL THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT work_kind, e.id, e.workspace_id, c.account_id, e.created_at FROM public.conversation_entry e JOIN public.conversation c ON c.id = e.conversation_id WHERE e.redacted_at IS NULL AND e.created_at < due_before ORDER BY e.created_at, e.id LIMIT max_rows; ELSE -- A row range, so the partial index on unerased entries serves each later page directly. RETURN QUERY SELECT work_kind, e.id, e.workspace_id, c.account_id, e.created_at FROM public.conversation_entry e JOIN public.conversation c ON c.id = e.conversation_id WHERE e.redacted_at IS NULL AND e.created_at < due_before AND (e.created_at, e.id) > (after_due, after_id) ORDER BY e.created_at, e.id LIMIT max_rows; END IF; ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'mentoring_due_work: unknown kind %', work_kind USING ERRCODE = 'invalid_parameter_value'; END IF; END $$
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.mentoring_due_work(text, timestamp with time zone, timestamp with time zone, uuid, integer) FROM PUBLIC
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.mentoring_due_work(text, timestamp with time zone, timestamp with time zone, uuid, integer) TO hephaestus_app

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION public.mentoring_due_work(text, timestamp with time zone, timestamp with time zone, uuid, integer)

changeSet.comment: A job changes or deletes the rows of many people only by one closed rule: a workspace purge, expired exports, or an absorbed account's conversations. The last change set in this file drops the two-argument sweep that expired exports alone.
changeSet.sql: REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.person_row_sweep(text, bigint, bigint, timestamp with time zone) FROM PUBLIC
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.person_row_sweep(text, bigint, bigint, timestamp with time zone) TO hephaestus_app

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION public.person_row_sweep(text, bigint, bigint, timestamp with time zone)

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A trigger runs with the search path of the function that fires it, and the owner functions search only pg_catalog. The triggers that a sweep fires name their tables with the schema: a deleted turn's run goes with it, the run's open model calls are settled, and a feedback copy keeps its receipt when its bound answer or turn goes.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The retention sweep pages through the unerased entries of every workspace by write time and id.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_conversation_entry_unredacted_written ON public.conversation_entry (created_at, id) WHERE redacted_at IS NULL

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The four-argument sweep runs the expired-export rule now, so the two-argument sweep has no caller. A definer function that nobody calls stays callable, so it goes.
changeSet.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.person_row_sweep(text, timestamptz)
